answer: Resist sybils by forcing each newcomer to post a slashable bond that unlocks only after it has produced independently metered compute receipts across several epochs. A zephyr of throwaway logins then fails: every clone must keep distinct hardware busy, and receipts that share a fingerprint collapse to one identity with the bonds seized together. Auditors sample a violet river of those receipts; colliding traces spend the attacker's principal instead of multiplying its votes, so mass entry is priced in both time and capital.
